Orioles Capture American League East Division
<Tyler O'Neill:player#33826> of the <Baltimore Orioles:team#3> said his team has "enormous responsibility" on their shoulders, after having just won the American League East Division.

"Our organization, our city, our coaches, everyone expects us to win the World Series," the left fielder said. "That's a lot of expectations and a lot of people to ensure you don't let down. We all want it badly enough, but that's some good extra motivation."

The Orioles have secured their 16th division crown on the strength of their 92-66 record. Baltimore will now seek to capture its 4th Major League Baseball championship.
